responsibility: NeXT/Darwin Objective-C runtime backend for ABI 2, the modern 64-bit Apple-style runtime. This file defines the ABI-2 metadata templates and hook implementations for class/category/protocol/ivar/property structures, selector and super-message references, fixup-based objc_msgSend variants, constant strings, protocol and exception-type records, and final emission of Objective-C 2 metadata; it also supplies ABI-2 exception integration, including OBJC_EHTYPE references, objc personality selection, begin/end catch calls, rethrow handling, and construction of try/catch/finally trees for the runtime.
